integrity: All universal conclusions follow from the analytic Fourier/refinement identity and a cited classical theorem, not finite experiments. The classical refinement formula itself is not asserted to be novel. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: All \(n\ge3\) at \(\lambda=1/m\) for integers \(m\ge2\); general \(\lambda<1\) is not covered. The classical unit-scale B-spline Zak unique-zero theorem is an explicit dependency. The exceptional even-scale frequency zero has order at least \(n+1\), without an exact multiplicity assertion. Historical originality is subject to earlier equivalent refinement results.
title: The reciprocal-integer Zak-zero parity law for higher-order centered B-splines
